subject: ICT
title: Let's Count and Colour
subtitle: Count and colour the circles
hero_picture: A boy, a girl and a cat watching a cartoon animal race on a TV screen, the girl counting on her fingers.

sections.heading: The animal race
text: Ammu is watching a race on TV.
How many animals are in the race?
sections.caption: Animals racing on TV
sections.picture: A TV screen showing four cute cartoon animals running a race: a squirrel, a rabbit, a fox and a deer.

sections.heading: Coloured circles
text: Three are red. One is white.
sections.caption: Counting coloured circles
sections.picture: A row of four circles on a whiteboard, three coloured red and one left white.

sections.heading: Look at the number
text: A number is shown at the top: 4.
sections.caption: A number and empty circles
sections.picture: A laptop screen showing a big number 4 and a row of five empty circles below it.

sections.heading: Click and check
text: Click on 4 circles to colour them.
If it is correct, you go to the next number!
points: Colour as many as the number
sections.caption: Colouring and checking
sections.picture: The same laptop screen with four circles coloured orange and one empty, a green tick button.

sections.heading: Count things around
text: Count the pebbles, buttons or leaves.
sections.caption: Counting pebbles
sections.picture: Children counting pebbles on the floor and putting them in small groups.

rhyme: Click on OK, check and see,
Counting is so fun for me!
activity: Draw 5 circles in your notebook. Colour as many as your age.
talk: How many animals were in the race?
What do we click to check the answer?
How many fingers on one hand?
summary: We count and colour the same number of circles as the number shown.

questions.prompt: The number shown is 4. How many circles do we colour?
questions.explanation: Colour as many circles as the number.

questions.prompt: What do we click to check our answer?
questions.explanation: The OK button checks the answer.

questions.prompt: 3 red and 1 white circle. How many red?
How many animals: squirrel, rabbit, fox, deer?
